description: Every App Store Connect + StoreKit 2 endpoint. 890 tools in 13 profiles, narrow to 27.
name: io.github.erayendes/asc-mcp

environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API Key ID. Normally written for you by `npx -y @erayendes/asc-mcp setup`.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect Issuer ID (a UUID). Normally written for you by `setup`.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID

environmentVariables.description: The .p8 private key as PEM text. Prefer `setup`, which stores it in the macOS Keychain instead of any config file; set this only where a Keychain is unavailable, such as CI.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to the .p8 file, as an alternative to pasting its contents. Off macOS this is what `setup` records.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Bundle ID of one app. Only needed by the StoreKit 2 transaction tools on the monetization profile.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_BUNDLE_ID

packageArguments.description: Which slice of App Store Connect to serve. One of app-info, distribution, monetization, marketing, access, testflight, analytics, provisioning, game-center, app-clips, xcode-cloud, webhooks, background-assets. Narrow further with a colon — monetization:subscription-pricing is 27 tools instead of 207. Omit it to serve the default working set, which is larger.

title: Heimdall
